name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper standard Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) Standard Terms, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys, allowing each party to disclose confidential information under mutually agreed protections.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement. Combined with the Standard Terms, it forms the complete executed MNDA once signed by both parties.

name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement covering access to and use of a cloud-hosted service between a provider and customer.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement governing early access to a product in exchange for feedback from a design partner.

name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement establishing uptime targets and service credits for a hosted product or service.

name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement covering the provision of professional services by a provider to a customer.

name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement governing the processing of personal data between a processor and a controller, including subprocessor relationships.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement covering licensing of software to a customer during a subscription period.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for two parties cooperating on a joint business initiative.

name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement covering HIPAA obligations and restrictions between a covered entity and a business associate.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement governing a customer's trial access to a product during a defined pilot period.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum covering the use of AI services as part of a product and the associated terms.
